prompt:
Handmade cut-paper collage for a 2D side-view adventure game. Every shape is a separate, flat piece of real paper – matte coloured construction paper, brown kraft paper, rough watercolour paper and thin translucent tissue paper – cut out with scissors or torn by hand and glued in overlapping layers. Clearly visible paper grain and fibres on every piece. Scissor-cut edges are crisp and slightly irregular; torn edges show a thin ragged white fibrous rim where the paper core shows. Details are smaller paper pieces glued on top: window frames, planks, stones, stripes, punched paper dots for buttons, rivets and stars. Each glued layer casts a thin soft shadow onto the paper directly beneath it. Bold, simple, slightly naive hand-cut shapes, few pieces, one flat matte colour per piece: no gradients inside a piece, no painted shading, no outlines, no ink or pencil lines, no airbrush, no glossy highlights. Dusk colours: deep indigo, violet and dusty rose papers in the sky, a strip of warm orange paper at the horizon, slate blue and teal papers for the sea, grey and ochre papers for stone, warm brown kraft paper for wood, dark green and red papers for accents; the lights are pieces of bright yellow paper. Not a painting, not a vector illustration, not a 3D render, not a photograph of a real place.
A sheet of separate cut-paper pieces for animating the same game scene, all at one common scale and in exactly the paper technique and colours of the second reference image. The first reference image is only a rough block mock-up of the layout: keep the position, size and outline of every object as in it, but take nothing of its flat colours or crude shapes; make every object properly as described, as cut paper.
The pieces, each one complete, none touching another, with clear empty space between all of them: at the top left a short wooden jetty seen exactly from the side, a long deck of kraft-paper planks on six wooden posts; below it two small wooden fishing boats seen exactly from the side, the left one smaller, each with a single mast, a furled sail and a little rigging of thin paper strips, their hulls complete down to the keel (no water); at the top right two flat cut-paper clouds in violet and rose; on the right a white seagull body seen from the side without wings, and next to it one separate long wing of white and grey paper; at the bottom right three soft smoke puffs of torn grey tissue paper of growing size. All pieces isolated on a fully transparent background, no shadow cast outside the pieces.
The pieces belong to this scene: Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
ref_note: The first image is only a rough block mock-up of the layout (positions and sizes); the second image shows the paper technique and colours of the game, not its content. Do not copy the flat colours of the mock-up.
